title: Mushroom Eye Galaxy
description: A surreal painting depicts a giant mushroom with a massive realistic human eye on its cap, containing a swirling galaxy and a woman's face within the pupil. A long-haired woman sleeps peacefully on top of the mushroom while the stem reveals a vertical panel of smaller cosmic eyes, planets and stars above a bed of smaller mushrooms, flowers and roots.
